messages:
Izzy Lane: Heads-up  customer hit timeouts during a weekend ramp. Can we draft a one-page "Quick Check" customers can run in a 10-min call to harden prefill + batching + streaming?
Marco Ruiz: Yep. Keep it snappy: 5 checklist items, 1 copy-paste curl, 1 jitter rule, 3 plain metrics and a tiny color legend.
Lina Moradi: Metrics that are easy to paste: prefill_success_rate, stream_p95_ms, inflight_len. Include suggested alarm numbers customers can use.
Izzy Lane: Quick checklist I'll propose: 1) One-off prefill top 8 prompts; 2) Use batch size 2-4; 3) Client timeout = 10-12s then streaming fallback; 4) Cache TTLs: ephemeral=5m, session=1h, static=12h; 5) Add jitter to prefill schedule.
Marco Ruiz: Copy-paste curl (one-liner):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"tenant":"acme","prompts":["welcome","summary"],"parallel":2}'
```
Jitter idea: schedule every 5m + rand(-30s..30s).
Lina Moradi: Suggested health legend (customer copy): GREEN = prefill_success_rate >= 75% AND stream_p95_ms < 500ms; YELLOW = prefill_success_rate 55-75% OR stream_p95_ms 500-800ms; RED = prefill_success_rate < 55% OR stream_p95_ms > 800ms OR sustained errors.
Izzy Lane: Renewal flag: if RED for 48h, recommend request temporary warm pool or book a troubleshooting call. Public contact: support@redwood.ai.
Marco Ruiz: Add one-line email template CS can send and a tiny feedback widget idea (thumbs up/down + one-line "what changed").
SupportBot: Draft uploaded internally; replace internal ops emails with support@redwood.ai for public copy.
Izzy Lane: Action: Marco to draft the one-pager, Lina to paste alarm snippets, I'll write the customer email. Target publish to enablement repo by tomorrow morning. Closing thread.
